card.name: Mid-sentence points in warning text
card.fires_on: Responds to a comma, linking word or partial word inside a list or phrase in warning text, just before the next clinical term is named. Examples are a comma in a differential diagnosis list and 'to' before 'fulminant hepatic necrosis'.

modes.label: Comma in a diagnosis list
modes.description: A comma after a condition in a list of differential diagnoses.
modes.example: include central anticholinergic toxicity<<,>> heat stroke, drug fever and primary central

modes.label: Link before a severe outcome
modes.description: A linking word such as 'to' or 'resembling' that comes before a described outcome or illness.
modes.example: starts with cholestatic jaundice and progresses<< to>> fulminant hepatic necrosis,

modes.label: Inside a drug name or phrase
modes.description: A partial drug name or a word early in a phrase such as 'During the initial phase'.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Japanese sentence-ending particles, so there is no clear link to English output.
